scope: Offline non-posted MMIO reserve/RX operation backend; no platform caller or DT integration
limitations: Synthetic MMIO model cannot prove real bus completion, mapping suitability, firmware behavior or Linux IRQ concurrency
No live IRQ/work/reset/generation owner integration; numeric generation is not hardware reset authority
Six full-page DT resources and binding changes are still required before a platform caller can map
Existing cfg and pending mappings must be replaced, never aliased with non-posted mappings
Ordinary readl/writel cannot return bus errors as callback errno
Port contexts are persistent and do not independently reject stale work after a new prepare
